title: Brookings report recommends possible withholding of ET artifacts

tellings.quote: And even before that, NASA commissioned uh the Brookings report in 1959. It was published in 1960.

plain: NASA commissioned the Brookings report, a study by the Brookings Institution, a Washington research group, in 1959, and it was published in 1960. As the researcher Maaneli Derakhshani describes it, the report raised the possibility of withholding from the public any discovery of artifacts left by beings from other worlds. He brings it up to suggest that keeping such finds secret was considered from the start of the space age.
